rows.name: confluent terminating repair contract
rows.statement: Declared repair moves close every covered local mismatch, overlapping moves complete to a common local diamond on the quotient, and every accepted nontrivial aggregate transaction strictly lowers one declared well-founded exact measure, so repair reduction terminates and normal endpoints from sources with equal protected observation agree exactly when the observation identifies consistent states. The contract is declared through the rows repair_completeness, local_diamond, and strict_well_founded_transactional_descent in claims/assumption_dictionary.md; the endpoint-uniqueness characterization is machine-checked in Lean/ObservableNormalForms/ObservableNormalForms/ObserverConfluence.lean.
rows.notes: Promotion is a recorded basis amendment of the shape specified in docs/CANONICAL_REPAIR_LAW_RFC.md and requires a basis-wide dependency and countermodel review.

rows.name: algebra-state representation of public records
rows.statement: Public records are represented as the span of the mutually orthogonal projectors of a projective partition inside a finite complex matrix star algebra, with states read through the trace pairing and record events using that declared algebraic readout surface. The representation is packaged in Lean/EventAlgebra/PublicRecordAlgebra.lean and declared as declared_record_surface in claims/assumption_dictionary.md.
rows.notes: Promotion would state the algebra-state readout surface as a basis clause; a source-produced representation theorem would retire the row instead.

rows.name: operational effect additivity
rows.statement: A public frame valuation is additive on every required coexistent effect sum, v(A + B) = v(A) + v(B) whenever A + B remains an effect, across measurement contexts. With this additivity the finite Busch-Gleason theorem in Lean/EventAlgebra/FiniteBuschGleason.lean forces the Born trace form; the same module carries the countermodel in which positivity, per-context normalisation, and continuity hold while cross-context additivity fails, and the row source_produced_public_effect_algebra_deferred in claims/assumption_dictionary.md records that the retained finite unsharp web admits a transverse cubic non-Born valuation.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-produced complex-tomographically-complete effect and instrument system with an operational theorem deriving noncontextual additivity on all required coexistent sums; lane #730 owns that scientific obligation. Lean/EventAlgebra/OperationalAdditivityBoundary.lean locates the row exactly on the committed produced system: the coexistent sums of two committed effects are precisely the unit resolutions (every committed effect has trace one, and in dimension two two trace-one effects coexist only as complements), any assignment sending the sure effect to one and normalised in each context is additive on all of them, and a machine-checked countermodel matching every produced count frequency, probability-valued on all effects, complement-consistent, and additive on every committed coexistent sum fails additivity at an explicit effect pair (35/64 against 143/256) and is the Born functional of no state; conversely full additivity plus the produced counts forces the run Born valuation and the committed run state uniquely. The committed produced system therefore cannot supply this premise; its removal still needs coexistent sums beyond the unit resolutions with an operational derivation of their additivity.

rows.name: phase-operation instrument
rows.statement: The phase operation completing the diagonal record algebra to full operator tomography is a declared instrument: the exact lift I/2 - (2*sqrt(3)/3)*i*(QP - PQ) generates the missing Pauli-Y projector and is tomographically complete on fixed-trace two-by-two matrices, while the producer supplies no phase operation, rotated or phase outcome receipts, common-preparation validation, or operational effect composition. The lift and its boundary are declared in code/born_context_phase_lift/README.md and in the row source_phase_sensitive_instrument_deferred of claims/assumption_dictionary.md.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-produced phase-sensitive operation/instrument with completely-positive outcome maps, a trace-preserving summed channel, effect/readback compatibility, common-preparation semantics, producer-bound receipts, and a preregistered statistical validation rule (or explicitly exhaustive deterministic semantics). Lean/EventAlgebra/OperationalPhaseInstrument.lean now deliberately types only IdealPhasePOVMCountModel, a static exact-fit model. Its synthetic_ideal_phase_fit theorem constructs an inhabitant from chosen rational literals with no producer, run, operation, or receipt, proving that exact POVM/count fit cannot by itself discharge PR-04. The diagonal/real-closure blindness theorems remain exact algebraic delimitations. Operational additivity/composition remains separately registered under PR-03. Lean/EventAlgebra/PhaseInstrumentDetermination.lean reduces the row's residue exactly: the committed diagonal literals pin the model state up to one complex off-diagonal coordinate, the phase clause is equivalent to a nonzero off-diagonal imaginary part for Hermitian effects, every count frequency of every inhabitant is an exact affine function of that coordinate (closed forms over the committed core for the phase and rotated-3 contexts), and phase counts obey the decidable window 32041(a-b)^2 <= 30192(a+b)^2 with both outcomes positive and minimal mass two. What the row keeps open is count provenance, source production of the phase operation, and common-preparation receipts; none is expressible inside the model, and the window is a necessary condition on any producer-bound phase receipt, never a provenance certificate. Recorded decision 2026-08-18 (lane issue 730, appended without altering the earlier note text): disposition changed from remove to axiomatize. The phase operation, the committed exact lift I/2 - (2*sqrt(3)/3)*i*(QP - PQ) declared in code/born_context_phase_lift, is a declared architecture operation. Information cost: one declared non-diagonal operation with exact matrix [[1/2, -i/2], [i/2, 1/2]], equal to the Pauli +Y projector. Phase-context and rotated-context counts are produced by an explicitly exhaustive deterministic semantics, one of the two validation routes the committed boundary text names as acceptable: exact Born arithmetic of the declared operation on the committed record-diagonal run state diag(111/179, 68/179), with counts as exact rational frequencies scaled to the least positive integer multiple of the committed run mass 179 that clears each denominator (phase (179, 179) at mass 358; rotated (315, 401) at mass 716; diagonal (111, 68) at mass 179). Producer, committed receipt, and independent verifier live in code/phase_operation_producer; the Lean inhabitant and composed receipt are Lean/EventAlgebra/OperationalPhaseAttainment.lean. No laboratory or emergent claim follows: the operation is declared, never source-produced; the counts are produced, never measured; PR-52 physical attachments stay open; the synthetic-inhabitant boundary of the no-go modules is unchanged; OL-C5 attainment is conditional structural under this axiomatized premise. Source production of a phase operation remains the open scientific obligation stated in this note.

rows.name: counting path reference
rows.statement: The path-space reference is a supplied initial law times the uniform-step counting weight; among row-stochastic kernels this normal form is characterized by invariance under independent relabeling of transition targets at fixed source, by row-constant weight, or by constant log-transition step action, and Axiom 3 selects neither the counting reference nor the trivial datum whose conditional resampling realizes it. The reference is formalized in Lean/InformationProjection/LogTransitionAction.lean; Lean/InformationProjection/ReferenceNormalForm.lean proves the characterization, and Lean/InformationProjection/SourceReferenceSelection.lean proves the counting-reference realization and the non-selection boundary.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source rule selecting the counting reference and the trivial datum; the relabeling-invariant normal form is characterized, and source selection remains deferred premise work under #739 after the scoped #731 composition milestone closed.

rows.name: real Legendre enrichment
rows.statement: The finite source law fixes its four-corner log-transition action and a bilinear real extension that is affine in the velocity slot; adding (a/2)*y*(y - 1) for any a > 0 changes no realized source history and yields strictly convex Legendre-Hamilton systems that differ between values of a. Selecting one real velocity curvature is therefore a representation choice beyond the realized-history law, proved as a sharp finite no-go in Lean/Variational/RealizedHistoryLegendreNoGo.lean with the bridge itself in Lean/Variational/LegendreBridge.lean.
rows.notes: Removal needs additional source data or a physical receipt selecting the off-alphabet real enrichment, which the realized-history law provably underdetermines. The declared mode-extremality rule fixes a = 2*log(362055879/271780) only after the admissible extensions are restricted to L_a = L_0 + (a/2)y(y-1). The complete quadratic classification proves that corner invisibility gives L_{a,c}, stationarity fixes a+c=a*, and the separately declared velocity-only clause fixes (a*,0) inside that quadratic grammar. The cubic control shows quadraticity is needed under stationarity alone, and the committed single-site minimum excludes that cubic family. It still does not select globally: for every 0<lambda<a*, the machine-checked quartic continuation L_lambda=L_a*+lambda*y^2*(y-1)^2 is corner-invisible and velocity-only, preserves the same stationarity and global fixed-endpoint single-site minimum, has an everywhere positive velocity Hessian and an invertible momentum map, and differs from every quadratic. Thus no tested clause bundle is a proved-minimal axiom system, and PR-06 remains active rather than discharged or ready for automatic axiomatization. A second-order boost clause is on record as a named candidate (Lean/Variational/PolynomialEnrichmentSelection.lean, BoostNullCovariant): every boost difference of a boost difference of the enrichment is a discrete null Lagrangian in the committed fixed-endpoint sense. Every quadratic-grammar sentence satisfies it; among velocity-only polynomial enrichments of every degree bound it holds exactly for the quadratic-affine members; the quartic continuation fails it at an explicit witness; and corner invisibility, velocity-only, the committed stationarity calibration, and the clause select exactly the committed point in the full two-slot polynomial grammar. The literal first-order boost clause fails at the committed increment itself, and the full grammar contains the boost-covariant, corner-invisible, stationarity-neutral antisymmetric cubic (x-y)^3-(x-y) outside the quadratics, so the velocity-only clause stays load-bearing; the module carries the mutation guard boostDiff_first_slot_guard. The clause is a declared candidate axiom, not a derived symmetry, and does not discharge this row.

rows.name: declared repair law: common faithful reference and repaired-visible fibre
rows.statement: One common faithful reference serves both Axiom 3 instantiations, and the transition feasible set is the fibre of the complete repaired visible datum of the active collar; on these two declared inputs the state projection selects the Gibbs exponential family and the transition projection selects weighted conditional resampling from the same reference, which yields the exact four-law package. The pair is declared through the row complete_repaired_visible_datum_fibre in claims/assumption_dictionary.md and consumed by Lean/Thermodynamics/FiniteConditionalRepair.lean; the B12 obstruction (code/thermodynamics/common_reference_obstruction/) and the B20 random-scan preflight (code/b20_random_scan/) prove that the pinned source run and its certified random-scan grammar do not supply the pair.
rows.notes: Promotion is the recorded axiomatization candidate of lane #732 with the B12/B20 bounded no-gos as its justification record; a simulator export realizing the law through the recorded-decision process would open the emergent rung.

rows.name: refinement-uniform low-temperature control
rows.statement: A declared indexed family carries one uniform low-temperature tail bound strong enough to drive the off-minimum Gibbs mass, and where claimed the entropy excess, to zero with one inverse-temperature threshold across the family. The original sufficient member uses a uniformly positive energy gap plus a uniform finite cardinality bound to obtain cardBound * exp(-beta * gapBound); its maps preserve minima but do not supply the later functorial and cofinal structure. The coherent-envelope route adds directed functorial data, and the ambient-cofinal route adds a nonterminal regulator embedding plus strict carrier growth on one supplied spectral-tail family. Neither route is asserted to be necessary for every growing regulator tower. A direct density-of-states or excited-to-ground degeneracy-ratio bound remains an allowed alternative.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-produced family with a proved uniform spectral-tail envelope and the regulator semantics required by the intended continuum claim; it does not require a uniform total-cardinality bound. CoherentRefinementFamily supplies the weaker directed-envelope layer and records its exact limitations. CofinalSpectralTailFamily adds an explicit nonempty ambient regulator preorder, an order-reflecting cofinal stage embedding, no maximal ambient stage, and data-level strict carrier growth. Its Nat ladder is nonconstant and unbounded, and constant finite carriers are formally excluded. fourLaws_composed_cofinal constructs the finite-law core directly and states every refinement conclusion on that same supplied family, including cofinal-tail concentration. Its calibrated-member theorem derives off-minimum-mass equality and the common envelope from a separately supplied calibrated-stage energy identification; it does not derive that identification. Strict cardinal growth is one sufficient genuine-refinement route, not a necessity claim for every possible physical regulator. No source produces this family or identifies its regulators, energy, inverse temperature, repair, or continuum interpretation, so PR-08 is substantially narrowed but not removed.

rows.name: equal-face-weight and barycentric one-third port-dual rules
rows.statement: The port-dual measure places equal normalized weights on the twenty faces of the oriented carrier, and each face's weight is shared barycentrically, one third to each incident port, giving the normalized port-dual weight 1/12. The rules are declared in code/b14_jacobi/port_dual_metric_selector.certificate.json (declared_rules.face_weighting and declared_rules.vertex_share), with the measure pinned by the committed theorem in Lean/Screen/PrimitivePortDualMeasure.lean.
rows.notes: Promotion would fix the face weighting and barycentric share as a basis measure clause; a source derivation of the port-dual measure would retire the row.

rows.name: measure-to-metric and nearest-point repair rules
rows.statement: The normalized port-dual measure is read as the diagonal carrier inner product it induces on port functions, and the discriminator verdict is the nearest classified compact family in the functorially induced bracket-space metric. Both rules are declared in code/b14_jacobi/port_dual_metric_selector.certificate.json (declared_rules.measure_to_metric and declared_rules.repair_rule) and in the row carrier_induced_invariant_metric_class_and_nearest_point_rule of claims/assumption_dictionary.md; neither is source-derived.
rows.notes: Promotion would fix the induced-metric reading and the nearest-point verdict as basis repair semantics; a source derivation of either rule would retire the row.

rows.name: compact-Lie classification inputs
rows.statement: Three Lie-theory facts enter the gauge classification as declared classical inputs: the direct-sum splitting L = Z(L) + [L, L] of a compact Lie algebra into invariant submodules, surjectivity of the exponential map on compact connected groups, and the classification of compact simple Lie algebras through its dimension list. The cited modules declare the remaining Lie-theoretic bridge steps of the classification (centre rationality through the torus/cocharacter step, the su(2)^4 fixed-space exclusion, and the reductive-decomposition boundary bundle) as classical inputs subsumed under this row. They are marked as inputs in Lean/Screen/A5OPH.lean and Lean/Screen/TrichotomyCases.lean and cited by paper/deriving_standard_model_gauge_structure_from_observer_overlap_consistency.tex.
rows.notes: The facts are classical compact-Lie theory consumed as imports; the row's only movement is machine-checked replacements for the paper citations, and no derivation obligation attaches.

rows.name: matter candidate grammar
rows.statement: A matter candidate is a pair (S, M): S a stratum of the classified compact locus of the fourteen-parameter equivariant Jacobi variety on the twelve-port carrier, and M a nonempty Z/2-graded finite-dimensional complex module of the complexified semisimple bracket at S with zero abelian charges and total dimension at most twelve, counted up to graded isomorphism and the global parity flip. The grammar, budget, observables, and decision rule are frozen before any comparison in code/b15_matter_freeze/matter_class_freeze_v1.json; the exterior selection boundary is recorded as exterior_Higgs_matter_selection in claims/assumption_dictionary.md.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-selection theorem that picks the physical matter module inside the frozen candidate class; grammar changes require a fresh freeze version before any evaluation.

rows.statement: For a positive-chamber face circulant with square-root masses sqrt(m_k) = sqrt(s)*(a + 2*rho*cos(delta + 2*pi*k/3)), the balance premise rho/a = 1/sqrt(2) makes the signed Koide quotient equal 2/3 exactly. The four-law claim in claims/claim_registry.yaml records laboratory energy and clock calibration as a named empirical input shared by the thermodynamics and constants lanes.

rows.statement: P and N are the two proposed fundamental free numerical parameters of the program. rows.name: layered shell-cardinality law

For the support-disjoint pair (86, 247) the split is backed by the kernel-checked support disjointness theorem supports_disjoint; the split itself is declared, and the designated pair (86, 88) has overlapping supports with no disjointness receipt.

rows.name: same-source loop-to-kernel identity
rows.statement: The carrier loop classes realized by the source are the six-axis screen gluing classes of Lean/Screen/Z6Exact.lean, and their image under the committed intertwiner sixAxisToKernel of Lean/Screen/Z6Descent.lean (axis generator to the kernel generator (omega_3 I_3, -I_2, e^{i pi/3}), antipodal sign reversal to conjugation, injective with image exactly the tensor-action kernel) generates the full Z6 tensor-action kernel of Lean/Screen/TraceBalancedKernel.lean. The corresponding maximal faithful tensor-action image is S(U(3) x U(2)), equivalently (SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1))/Z6. The realized local weights descend through all four admissible quotients (Z6Descent.four_admissible_global_forms), so the same-source loop-to-kernel identity is one necessary clause toward selecting the physical quotient; it does not select that quotient without PR-46. The intertwiner itself is a proved receipt, and the premise is the same-source physical identification of its domain.
rows.notes: Removal needs a same-source holonomy theorem computing the carrier loop classes from the source packet and matching them to the kernel through the committed intertwiner; the companion character-category completeness residual remains open. Registration keeps OL-G2 conditional with the premise named.

rows.name: family band-selection rules: single complete faithful band and operational cost order
rows.statement: The family multiplicity object is a single complete spectral band of the twelve-port adjacency realized inside the screen coefficient space: candidates carrying a source-visible proper splitting projector are excluded (the single-complete-object clause), bands whose rotation action has nontrivial kernel are excluded (the faithfulness clause), and the complex dimension lies in the pinned physical window [3, 5]. Admissible candidates are compared by the operational Laplacian seam cost per unit norm over Z[sqrt5], and the unique strict minimizer is selected. On the committed carrier the admissible candidates are the 3, 3', and 5 bands with exact costs 5 - sqrt5 < 6 < 5 + sqrt5, so the rules select the rank-three band (Lean/Screen/A5FamilyBand.lean, family_band_selected); without the faithfulness clause the minimizer is the trivial band at cost zero (trivial_band_without_faithfulness), so the clause is load-bearing. The clauses are declared in code/a5_closure/family_band_attachment_certificate.py and its reference manifest.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source derivation of the comparison order and of the realization clause that places the multiplicity object inside the screen coefficient space; registration composes OL-G4 conditionally, and family triplication stays a selection under these rules.

rows.name: fine-structure closure map selection
rows.statement: The P-closure map consumed by the fine-structure lane is a declared selection: the one-loop running and matching conventions, the tree-level m_Z closure, and the continuation masses enter as declared map data, certified as declared in the interval contraction certificate, and no source rule selects this map among admissible closure maps.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-selection theorem for the closure map; with the row registered the fine-structure row states its map ancestry against the register and the diagnostic keeps its missing pieces exactly named.

rows.name: same-quantity bridge for the P closure
rows.statement: The screen detuning reading of P and the electromagnetic return reading are the same typed quantity, so the fixed point of the declared closure map and the fine-structure return value factor through one same-invariant identification; the physical-identification row p_detuning_same_quantity_readback records the bridge as an undischarged anchor.
rows.notes: Registration legitimizes conditional use; removal needs the commuting same-quantity readback certificate named in the physical-identification registry.

rows.name: physical Thomson readback contract
rows.statement: The Thomson endpoint transport attaches to the physical Thomson scheme through a declared readback contract; the endpoint receipt consumes the contract as declared, and the physical-identification row alpha_in_thomson records the physical attachment as an undischarged anchor.
rows.notes: Removal needs the source-attached Thomson readback; until then the endpoint stays compare-only.

rows.name: payload-coherent anchor-gap premise
rows.statement: The coherent charged-lepton kappa closure consumes one declared premise: the anchor gap is coherent with the pinned hadronic payload across the three charged channels, which narrows the certified rectangle intervals to the coherent intervals by the recorded factor.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source derivation of the payload-coherent anchor gap; every coherent-interval row is conditional on the premise and the rectangle intervals stand without it.

rows.name: electroweak sector selection premises
rows.statement: The conditional Higgs and top rows of the electroweak section consume declared selection premises; the postdiction ledger records the rows as conditional on the declared selection axioms, and the sector stance is owed.
rows.notes: Registration names the selection premises the compare-only rows consume; a source selection theorem or a recorded sector stance retires the row.

rows.name: horizon record central-charge identification
rows.statement: Over the declared repair law (PR-07), the modular weight of the declared reference splits as -log ref = 2*pi*B + Z, with the central charge Z measurable through the repaired visible datum; the identification of B with a physical boost energy and of Z with the edge record of a physical horizon is content of the row. The 2*pi coefficient is the declared modular normalization of the split.
rows.notes: Composes with PR-07 (declared repair law) and PR-15 (clock and energy calibration anchors). The composition with the repair kernel conserves the central charge with no further hypothesis, so the cap Clausius inequality carries no independent temperature input. No continuum horizon exists on the finite model; horizon temperature in physical units stays with PR-15 plus the horizon-dictionary content of this row. Evidence context: Lean/Thermodynamics/HorizonThermalitySurface.lean: structure HorizonRecordData; theorems HorizonSurface.horizon_cap_clausius; HorizonSurface.entanglement_first_law_exact; HorizonSurface.entanglement_first_law_first_order; HorizonSurface.modular_weight_double_identification

rows.name: pointwise-continuous public star-automorphism flow
rows.statement: A real-parameter group of star automorphisms of one represented finite matrix algebra is supplied, with identity at zero, the group law, and pointwise continuity. The finite Stone-converse receipt then represents that supplied flow by conjugation with a time-independent self-adjoint generator, unique up to an additive real scalar. The premise supplies neither a source-selected evolution nor a physical clock.
rows.notes: Removal needs the observer protocol to emit the automorphism group and its source-selected generator. Physical-time calibration remains a separate PR-15 attachment.

rows.name: finite subsystem split and normalized local-operation interface
rows.statement: The finite locality helpers are read on a supplied bipartite carrier split with a designated local factor and a normalized local operation: a row-normalized classical kernel or Kraus-complete quantum family. Adaptive variants additionally take a supplied scheduler and consultation region. These data yield exact algebraic no-signalling and dependency-cone identities but do not identify spacelike physical regions, a laboratory channel, or a source-selected factorization.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-produced subsystem or region split, normalized channel semantics, and scheduler provenance. PR-52 separately owns the physical spacetime and causal reading.

rows.name: source-selected real variational dynamics and symmetry data
rows.statement: The variational surface is supplied with a positive initial law and transition kernel, a finite history length, a record embedding of the alphabet into the reals, a real Lagrangian or stiffness and potential with derivative data, and, for Noether transport, a differentiable one-parameter transformation and exact invariance law. The finite Euler-Lagrange, Legendre-Hamilton, and Noether receipts are conditional on these data and are stated for fixed-endpoint interior-junction variations; the observer source does not select them.
rows.notes: Removal needs one source-derived real history action, potential, symmetry action, and physical clock that compose with the path reference and real enrichment rather than merely standing beside them.

rows.name: physical global-form selection attachments
rows.statement: Selection of the physical global gauge group from the four quotients compatible with the realized local weights requires a source-complete character category, an instanton or topological normalization, and a laboratory flux or line-operator attachment. The finite kernel, six-axis intertwiner, and four-quotient menu do not supply those identifications.
rows.notes: Removal needs a same-source physical discriminator that selects one quotient and rules out the other three without importing the observed Standard Model global form. The finite character-lattice piece of the bundle is machine-checked in Lean/Screen/GlobalFormCharacterDescent.lean: the descent congruence 2t + 3d + q = 0 mod 6 as an iff against the full kernel action, every committed table row, a blocked control label, and the exact one-sixth count; the complete character category, instanton normalization, laboratory flux attachment, and physical quotient selection are exactly the remaining open content of this row.

rows.name: spacetime Spin and fermion-chirality attachment
rows.statement: The parity-graded exterior component table is attached to a physical Lorentzian Spin structure, odd-Weyl fermion typing, and fermion parity so that the finite table grading has the claimed spacetime chirality meaning. The central arithmetic and parity scan do not construct this attachment.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-selected Lorentzian Spin lift that composes with the exterior matter carrier and its local dynamics.

rows.name: one-Higgs scalar carrier and kinetic-action attachment
rows.statement: One complex weak doublet of hypercharge one half is selected as the physical scalar carrier, identified with the declared weak block, and furnished with a gauge-covariant kinetic action and normalization. The exterior table and central-weight arithmetic identify a compatible candidate but do not select its physical existence or dynamics.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source action that selects the scalar carrier and fixes its kinetic normalization rather than assuming the one-Higgs branch.

rows.name: renormalizable Higgs potential and electroweak-breaking law
rows.statement: The scalar sector carries the renormalizable quadratic-plus-quartic Higgs potential, a stable symmetry-breaking branch, and a vacuum attachment with a declared relation to the physical electroweak scale. No committed OPH theorem selects the potential, its coefficients, or the broken vacuum.
rows.notes: Removal needs a target-clean source-derived stable scalar potential, vacuum, and scale bridge. Until then electroweak breaking is a registered premise, not an OPH result.

rows.name: Yukawa interaction-line and coupling-matrix attachment
rows.statement: The gauge-invariant up, down, and charged-lepton interaction lines are selected on the one-Higgs matter package and furnished with complete Yukawa matrices, including family labels and physical chiral attachment. The exterior grammar records compatible invariant lines, while exact non-identifiability receipts show that it does not determine their matrices, eigenvalues, textures, or phases.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-derived interaction action selecting all three matrices without measured mass or mixing ancestry.

rows.name: common screen-electroweak load and capacity bridge
rows.statement: The A5-invariant screen-load line and the electroweak scalar order-unit line are identified by one refinement-natural positive unital readout, and that same typed load is attached to the global capacity action used by the conditional N closure. The current branch certificate explicitly leaves the common-load identification and inherited screen-electroweak bridge premises open.
rows.notes: Removal needs a target-independent same-quantity theorem and a source-derived global capacity action; registering the row licenses only conditional ancestry.

rows.name: observer-to-physical-spacetime and causal attachment
rows.statement: The intrinsic Lorentz module, null cone, event-germ atlas, and declared finite causal regions are jointly identified with one observer-produced physical spacetime, including compatible rods, operational clocks, causal reachability, refinement, and continuum soldering. The existing algebraic geometry and finite-net modules explicitly do not construct this joint attachment.
rows.notes: Removal needs one source-derived, refinement-compatible spacetime witness and explicit maps from the finite observer records to its causal and metric structure. TripleCarrierJoin places both committed pair paths, counted states, and checkpoint families on one finite carrier, but supplies no physical regions, spacetime, causality, or clock. Evidence context: Lean/Geometry/CausalOrderComposition.lean composes the committed finite region orders with the causal order of the declared Lorentz module through declared vertex assignments, with two-directional order equivalence, disjointness-to-spacelike receipts, and oriented-chart and overlap-cocycle invariance; the module and the assignments are declared, so this row stays open. Lean/Geometry/CommonWorldIslandBridge.lean joins the screen Gram quotient to the rest fiber of the witness frame as a typed metric-exact dictionary and states that no physical position, rod, or spacetime attachment is claimed, so the row stays open.

rows.name: physical finite-carrier propagation, frame, and comparison attachment
rows.statement: A named branch-indexed finite-carrier propagation action is identified with a physical photon or other declared field sector, a coherent frame and boost law, a calibrated clock and length scale, a cofinal gluing or continuum domain, and an operational wave-packet readout with nuisance and comparison semantics. The primitive-port rank-six and seam-current rank-two actions are distinct branches; their exact internal dispersion coefficients alone supply none of these attachments.
rows.notes: Removal needs a target-clean physical field/readout bridge. LocalFaceMaxwellAction supplies an exact finite static local-curvature action and TemporalMaxwellEvolution supplies an exact declared-step leapfrog evolution with continuity, energy, gauge, static-Coulomb, and wave receipts; a calibrated frame/scale, physical source or readout, and continuum attachment stay missing. A predictive comparison remains ineligible until this row and the applicable frozen decision-rule and power requirements are met. The common-world island bridge carries only the derived rank-three control quotient; the twelve ports, thirty seams, and twenty faces have no map to points, intervals, or cones of the declared module, so the row stays open.

rows.name: source gauge-field, current, and action attachment
rows.statement: The selected compact bracket and matter representation are realized by one source-produced gauge connection, current algebra, field strength, covariant matter operator, and local action on the same spacetime carrier. The finite classification and invariant-form receipts determine conditional algebraic shapes but do not construct this physical field/action package.
rows.notes: Removal needs one observer-native gauge and matter action that composes with the spacetime, quantum, and calibration lanes. LocalFaceMaxwellAction supplies a local finite U(1)-shaped static vector action plus a separate scalar Coulomb action, but it types port charge and seam current separately; TemporalMaxwellEvolution proves the typed continuity equivalence along the declared evolution without identifying the two source types; a matter operator, physical source production, spacetime attachment, and nonabelian sector stay missing.

rows.name: declared baryon- and lepton-number labels
rows.statement: The ten one-generation Weyl-field labels are furnished with the displayed accidental baryon number B and lepton number L. These labels are used to classify baryon-violating dimension-six field multisets and to state Delta B equals Delta L. Gauge representation and hypercharge data do not by themselves derive these two global labels or prove their conservation.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-side definition of the accidental charges on the physical matter carrier. The finite census remains conditional on the displayed labels.

rows.name: dimension-six baryon-operator eligibility and contraction grammar
rows.statement: Candidate dimension-six baryon operators are represented by ordered four-field multisets on the declared one-generation Weyl table and filtered by exact hypercharge neutrality, color triality, weak parity, Lorentz-chirality parity, and nonzero baryon label. Surviving rows are tested in the supplied epsilon-contraction and exterior-algebra grammar. The exhaustive finite result proves completeness only inside this declared grammar.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-derived effective-operator domain and a proof that the finite grammar is complete for the physical low-energy action.

rows.name: physical proton state and baryon-violating effective-action attachment
rows.statement: The declared quark and lepton fields, baryon labels, and finite operator census are attached to a physical proton state and one low-energy effective action with source-selected Wilson coefficients, renormalization and scale conventions, QCD matrix elements, and decay readout. Without this attachment the census neither proves proton stability nor predicts a lifetime.
rows.notes: Removal needs one common observer realization of the matter, QCD, and action construction plus an operational decay comparison. The current exact result is only a conditional finite operator census.

rows.name: time-indexed net evolution and time-slice generation interface
rows.statement: No registered premise supplies a time-indexed or Cauchy-region interface together with a net-compatible evolution and a theorem that the algebra generated from one admitted slice equals the algebra of the corresponding evolved region. PR-43 supplies a flow on one full matrix block with no regional compatibility, PR-52 owns the physical time and causal reading, and the constructed Z/2 slot swap is only an internal finite symmetry. These are distinct ingredients: a continuous symmetry action is neither necessary nor sufficient by itself for the time-slice property.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-selected time-indexed or Cauchy-region interface and a net-compatible evolution proving the required slice-to-region generation or isomorphism. A continuous flow, a moving region family, equal algebras for Cauchy neighborhoods, or a fixed algebra with coherent nontrivial dynamics are possible routes; none is the definition by itself. PathTimeSliceInterface gives only a finite one-step transport-aware interface. TripleCarrierJoin supplies one common state/path/checkpoint carrier and exact intertwining across the 31 actual adjacent source transitions, but its positive trace-preserving marginals are not algebra or net morphisms and no tower-state identification is made. Neither module supplies a multi-step cocycle, Cauchy geometry, clock, physical time, or source selection. CarrierJoinTransport delimits the corrected interface's region freedom (region-preserving evolutions force step-invariant regions; any change is a slot exchange) and exhibits a slot-exchanging time-dependent inhabitant; the source-selected time-slice content of the premise stays open.

rows.name: declared five-mode exterior component and mask-selection grammar
rows.statement: The bounded exterior-matter receipts supply the five-mode carrier V = C^3 + C^2 with trace-balanced integer charges q = 6Y = (-2, 3), omit exterior degrees zero and five, and use the ten remaining nontrivial isotypic rows with their committed color and weak dimensions, q6 column, exterior parity, and conjugation. The finite selection domain is exactly the 2^10 subsets of that table; admissibility requires nonemptiness, no row together with its conjugate, and vanishing of the displayed mixed gravitational-U(1), SU(3)^2 U(1), SU(2)^2 U(1), and U(1)^3 sums. This declared charged rank-fifteen exterior-table and mask grammar is distinct from the separately frozen PR-12 class, whose candidates have dimension at most twelve and zero abelian charges. Neither class contains the other. PR-59 neither source-selects physical matter nor proves completeness against other carriers, direct sums, vectorlike additions, neutral singlets, or light sectors.
rows.notes: Removal needs a source-selected five-mode carrier and exterior table together with outcome-independent completeness against the relevant alternative matter carriers, or a genuinely fresh preregistered replacement grammar spanning them. PR-12 is a separate negative-control and search class, not a superset from which PR-59 can be selected. The two surviving masks are exact only inside the declared PR-59 table.

rows.name: admissible scheduler class: mismatch non-increase clause
rows.statement: Every supported step of an admissible scheduler on the two-register repair carrier does not increase the declared defect mismatch, one unit per raised private defect flag. Typed as the mismatch_nonincrease clause of ObservableNormalForms.ProtectedObstructions.SchedulerClass.AdmissibleScheduler in Lean/ObservableNormalForms/ObservableNormalForms/SchedulerClassObstructions.lean; the all-scheduler defect cut consumes exactly this clause.
rows.notes: Declared clause of the admissible scheduler class; the only class-constraint row consumed by an obstruction theorem in the committed slice (all_scheduler_defect_cut). Consumed by OPH-CONS-SCHEDULER-CLASS-CAPACITY-SPLIT. Promotion into the basis is a recorded register decision; no source theorem produces the clause.

rows.name: admissible scheduler class: single-register locality clause
rows.statement: Every supported step writes at most one of the two registers, typed as the locality clause over the declared LocalMove grammar in Lean/ObservableNormalForms/ObservableNormalForms/SchedulerClassObstructions.lean. Declared; no obstruction theorem consumes it.
rows.notes: Declared clause of the admissible scheduler class; typed but consumed by no obstruction theorem in the committed slice. Consumed as a class-membership constraint by OPH-CONS-SCHEDULER-CLASS-CAPACITY-SPLIT, whose status records the clause as not load-bearing.

rows.name: admissible scheduler class: unit expected capacity clause
rows.statement: The expected declared capacity spend of every step, stepCost = privateCost + sharedCost integrated against the kernel row, is at most one unit, typed as the capacity_bound clause in Lean/ObservableNormalForms/ObservableNormalForms/SchedulerClassObstructions.lean. Declared; no obstruction theorem consumes it.
rows.notes: Declared clause of the admissible scheduler class; typed but consumed by no obstruction theorem in the committed slice. Consumed as a class-membership constraint by OPH-CONS-SCHEDULER-CLASS-CAPACITY-SPLIT, whose status records the clause as not load-bearing.

rows.name: two-register capacity-split reading
rows.statement: The first register of the committed two-bit repair carrier is read as the shared network-facing record and the second as the private local defect flag; privateCost charges one unit per private write and sharedCost one unit per shared write, and the self-update-only and network-update-only sub-classes are their zero-spend loci. The reading is a declaration, not a derivation.
rows.notes: Declared reading behind the capacity split; the typed costs and sub-class loci are machine-checked in the evidence module. Consumed as a class-membership constraint by OPH-CONS-SCHEDULER-CLASS-CAPACITY-SPLIT; no source theorem selects the reading.
